one_liner: Web data API for AI agents to search, scrape, crawl, map, parse and interact with the live web, returning clean Markdown or structured JSON; official MCP server included.
access_notes: Self-serve: free tier with 1,000 monthly credits; keyless basic calls also allowed.
mcp_notes: Hosted MCP at mcp.firecrawl.dev with OAuth or API key modes.

evidence.quote: API — call the Firecrawl REST endpoints directly, no Authorization header required
Free tier — 1,000 credits every month, refreshed monthly, no credit card required. … Effective September 4, 2026.
Confirm the URL is exactly ‘https://mcp.firecrawl.dev/v2/mcp-oauth’ (or ‘https://mcp.firecrawl.dev/v2/mcp’ with your API key header).
You can now pass a ‘webhook’ parameter to the ‘/crawl’ endpoint… events: ‘crawl.started’… ‘crawl.page’… ‘crawl.completed’… ‘crawl.failed’.
Every change fires a signed webhook with custom headers and per-event subscriptions
‘serve’ answers the Firecrawl v2 API on port 3002… local routes need no API key.
